notes.title: Stay Alive My Son (PC): A Survivor’s Story, Cambodia’s Genocide-50th Anniversary
notes.notes: The 50th anniversary of the Cambodian Genocide marks a solemn remembrance of the nearly two million lives lost under the Khmer Rouge regime from 1975 to 1979. This milestone serves as a time for survivors to share their stories, for younger generations to learn from history, and for the world to reflect on the resilience of the Cambodian people. Commemorations honor those who perished while reaffirming the commitment to justice, education, and the prevention of future atrocities. Through remembrance, Cambodia continues to heal, ensuring that the horrors of the past are never forgotten.
